claims.content: Retrieve historic reports from the COTS reporting system based on date range and report name.

goal.raw_text: Retrieve historic reports from the COTS reporting system based on date range and report name.

claims.content: Management
Previously created report results are stored in the RLCS and are retrievable for a minimum period of 60 days, configurable for up to one year.
The RLCS database stores historical transaction data to generate reports of system operations.
A commercial off-the-shelf reporting tool is used for the reporting function.
The COTS reporting system supports retrieval of historic reports based on date range and report name.
Management requests retrieval of historic reports from the COTS reporting system based on date range and report name.

trigger.raw_text: Management requests retrieval of historic reports from the COTS reporting system based on date range and report name.

claims.content: The user initiates retrieval of historic reports from the COTS reporting system based on date range and report name.
The user specifies the date range and report name for the historic report.
The COTS reporting system retrieves the historic report based on the specified date range and report name.
At main flow step 1, if the specified report name is "Current Command Summary Report", the report screen supports display/modify parameters for the "Current Command Summary Report" (3.2.1.9.1).
At main flow step 1, if the specified report name is "Event Log Report", the report screen supports display/modify parameters for the "Event Log Report" (3.2.1.9.2).
At main flow step 1, if the specified report name is "Current System Status Report", the report screen supports display/modify parameters for the "Current System Status Report" (3.2.1.9.3).
At main flow step 1, if the specified report name is "Schedule Report", the report screen supports display/modify parameters for the "Schedule Report" (3.2.1.9.4).
At main flow step 1, if the specified report name is "Failure Summary Report", the report screen supports display/modify parameters for the "Failure Summary Report" (3.2.1.9.5).
At main flow step 1, if the specified report name is "Current Command Report", the report screen supports display/modify parameters for the "Current Command Report" (3.2.1.9.6).
At main flow step 1, if the specified report name is "Current User Report", the report screen supports display/modify parameters for the "Current User Report" (3.2.1.9.7).
At main flow step 1, if the specified report name is "Safety Report", the report screen supports display/modify parameters for the "Safety Report" (3.2.1.9.8).
At main flow step 1, the specified report name may be "Other Management Reports".
At main flow step 1, the specified report name may be "PIER Report".
At main flow step 2, if the requested report results were previously created, retrieve them from the RLCS for a minimum period of 60 days, but configurable for up to one year.
Historic reports are retrieved from the COTS reporting system based on date range and report name.
